name: RethinkFun
descriptionZh: 面向初学者的中文深度学习教程，从数学基础、线性回归一路讲到神经网络、Transformer 与大模型，强调慢下来理解技术细节。
descriptionEn: A Chinese deep-learning course for beginners that builds from math and linear regression through neural networks, Transformers and modern LLMs.

name: GitStudy
descriptionZh: AI 驱动的开源代码学习平台：看项目骨架、补前置知识、读源码、做题，并在浏览器实验室里调参数看结果。
descriptionEn: An AI-assisted way to learn open-source projects through architecture views, prerequisite knowledge, source reading, quizzes and browser labs.

name: Hello-Agents
descriptionZh: Datawhale 的系统性智能体教程，从基础理论到实际应用，强调从核心原理出发理解并亲手构建 Agent 系统。
descriptionEn: Datawhale's systematic, practice-oriented tutorial for understanding and building AI-native agent systems from first principles.

name: Dive into Deep Learning (D2L)
descriptionZh: 《动手学深度学习》中文开源项目，把概念、数学、可运行代码与练习放在一起，适合系统补齐深度学习基础。
descriptionEn: The Chinese edition of Dive into Deep Learning, combining concepts, mathematics, runnable code and exercises in one open resource.

name: AI for Beginners
descriptionZh: 微软开源的 12 周、24 课 AI 入门课程，包含阅读、Notebook、实验、测验，并提供简体中文支持。
descriptionEn: Microsoft's beginner-friendly 12-week, 24-lesson AI curriculum with notebooks, labs, quizzes and multilingual support.

name: Generative AI for Beginners
descriptionZh: 微软的生成式 AI 入门课程，以 Learn / Build 两类课组织概念和 Python / TypeScript 示例，并提供多语言版本。
descriptionEn: Microsoft's 21-lesson Generative AI course mixing concept-focused Learn lessons with Python/TypeScript Build lessons.

name: Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
descriptionZh: Andrej Karpathy 的神经网络课程，从反向传播等基础开始，跟着视频一起手写、训练网络，并配套 Notebook 与练习。
descriptionEn: Andrej Karpathy's from-the-basics neural-network course: code and train networks alongside the videos, notebooks and exercises.

name: Happy-LLM
descriptionZh: Datawhale 的《从零开始构建大模型》，从 NLP 研究方法、Transformer 到预训练、微调，并动手实现小型 LLM。
descriptionEn: Datawhale's open tutorial for understanding LLMs from NLP foundations through Transformers, pretraining, finetuning and hands-on implementation.

name: LLMs from Scratch
descriptionZh: Sebastian Raschka 的逐步实现路线，从文本数据、Attention 到 GPT 预训练和指令微调，适合想真正理解 LLM 内部机制的人。
descriptionEn: Sebastian Raschka's step-by-step implementation path from text data and attention to GPT pretraining and instruction finetuning.

name: Hugging Face Agents Course
descriptionZh: 免费的 Agent 课程，从 Agent 基础、框架到 Agentic RAG 和最终项目，包含实践与评估环节。
descriptionEn: A free agents course covering fundamentals, major frameworks, Agentic RAG, hands-on exercises and a final evaluated project.

name: The Thinking Game
descriptionZh: 关于 Google DeepMind 团队与长期 AI 研究的一部纪录片。适合放在课程后半段，作为“为什么有人会向往科研”的文化切片。
descriptionEn: A documentary about the people and long-term research culture around Google DeepMind, used here as inspiration rather than a picture of everyday lab life.

name: RDKit
descriptionZh: 经典开源化学信息学工具箱，可用于分子表示、描述符、指纹、相似性、反应处理等，是化学 ML 工作流里的基础设施之一。
descriptionEn: A foundational open-source cheminformatics toolkit for molecular representations, descriptors, fingerprints, similarity and reactions.

name: RDKit.js
descriptionZh: RDKit 的 JavaScript / WebAssembly 分发，非常适合本网站后续实现浏览器内分子绘制、指纹和交互式表示演示。
descriptionEn: The JavaScript/WebAssembly distribution of RDKit, useful for in-browser molecular depictions and interactive representation demos.

name: DeepChem
descriptionZh: 面向分子、药物、材料与科学机器学习的开源工具和学习生态，适合从教程走向真实分子 ML 代码。
descriptionEn: An open-source scientific machine-learning ecosystem spanning molecular, drug-discovery and materials workflows.

name: Chemprop
descriptionZh: 以消息传递神经网络为核心的分子性质预测框架，适合作为“分子图如何进入模型”的真实项目案例。
descriptionEn: A molecular property-prediction framework centered on message-passing neural networks and a strong real-project example for graph-based chemistry ML.

name: SchNetPack
descriptionZh: 面向原子体系和量子化学性质的神经网络工具箱，可用于理解 3D 原子表示、原子势能与 atomistic ML。
descriptionEn: A toolbox for neural networks on atomistic systems and quantum-chemical properties, useful for 3D representations and atomistic ML.

name: Open Reaction Database
descriptionZh: 开放反应数据基础设施，可作为反应预测、合成与实验设计中“数据如何组织”的真实案例。
descriptionEn: Open reaction-data infrastructure for synthesis research and data-driven reaction modeling.

name: FAIRChem
descriptionZh: FAIR Chemistry 的开源模型、数据和工具集合，覆盖计算化学、材料与催化等方向。
descriptionEn: Open models, datasets and tools from FAIR Chemistry for computational chemistry, materials science and catalysis.

name: pymatgen
descriptionZh: Materials Project 生态中的核心开源材料分析库，适合材料结构、数据处理与后续 AI 工作流。
descriptionEn: A core open-source materials-analysis library in the Materials Project ecosystem and a useful foundation for materials ML workflows.

name: AlphaFold
descriptionZh: Google DeepMind 的蛋白质结构预测开源代码，是“AI 如何改变一个科学问题”的代表性案例之一。
descriptionEn: Google DeepMind's open protein-structure prediction code and a landmark example of AI changing a scientific workflow.
